card.name: Words right after become, be, evolve
card.fires_on: The word right after a verb of change or state like become, be, evolve, develop (e.g. 'Become Good<< News>>', 'have been<< younger>>'). It also appears at words that signal a change or a revised state such as 'updated', 'modify' and 'once projected'.

modes.label: After become/be
modes.description: The word that fills the slot after a verb of becoming or being, naming the new state.
modes.example: Can Christ Become Good<< News>> Again? (1991);

modes.label: Change or revision words
modes.description: Verbs or adverbs about development, updating or modifying something.
modes.example: The College reserves the right to<< modify>> or cancel any course, program, fee

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning 'turned into' and 'initially' (变成, transformed, initially), so it seems to lower the chance of change-of-state wording next.
card.plain: It marks words that come just after phrases about becoming or changing, such as 'become', 'evolve' or 'modify'.
